sn6.12:1.2: Ekaṃ damayaṃ Bhagavā Rājagahe viharati Gijjhakūṭe pabbate acirapakkante Devadatte || || 2.
sn6.12:1.3: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati abhikkantāya rattiyā abhikkantavaṇṇo kevalakappaṃ Gijjhakūṭam pabbatam obhāsetvā yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antam aṭṭhāsi || || 3.
sn6.12:1.4: Ekam antaṃ ṭhito kho Brahmā sahampati Devadattam ārabbha Bhagavato santike imaṃ gātham abhāsi || ||
